name: SimGlot
description: Artifact for an empirical study that treats an LLM agent benchmark's evaluation harness -- its task suite, input generator and reward function -- as software under test. It contains the oracle-integrity auditing suite (eight checks in two families), a twenty-one-variant fault-injection battery over seven defect classes, the analyses behind every table and figure in the paper, and the version-binding records that tie each number to a frozen archive revision.
